import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a new column for dog age groups
data['DogAgeGroup'] = pd.cut(data['AlterVHundNum'], bins=[0, 1, 3, 5, 10, 20], labels=['0-1', '1-3', '3-5', '5-10', '10+'])

# Aggregate data by district and dog age group
agg_data = data.groupby(['KreisLang', 'DogAgeGroup']).size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Setup the figure
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Create a bar plot
sns.barplot(data=agg_data, x='KreisLang', y='Count', hue='DogAgeGroup')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Dogs by Age Group Across Districts in Zurich', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.legend(title='Dog Age Group', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a new column for dog age groups
data['DogAgeGroup'] = pd.cut(data['AlterVHundNum'], bins=[0, 1, 3, 5, 10, 20], labels=['0-1', '1-3', '3-5', '5-10', '10+'])

# Aggregate data by district and dog age group
agg_data = data.groupby(['KreisLang', 'DogAgeGroup']).size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Setup the figure
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Create a bar plot
sns.barplot(data=agg_data, x='KreisLang', y='Count', hue='DogAgeGroup')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Dogs by Age Group Across Districts in Zurich', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
